//: Meridian — deterministic gates for the SEPA fee-change workflow (MFIN-2088).
THE ONE THING THAT WILL CATCH YOU OUT:
VS Code ignores the 'matcher' field. Every hook below fires on EVERY tool
invocation, so each script filters on tool_name read from stdin. A hook
copied from a Claude Code example looks correct and silently gates the
wrong tools. The matchers below are kept only as documentation of intent.
NOTHING HERE IS LOAD-BEARING. The same rules are enforced one rung lower by
scripts/loop.sh and scripts/verify-change.sh, which work with no hook support
at all. Hooks upgrade 'the agent is told to stop' into 'the agent cannot
proceed' — that is the whole difference, and it is worth a lot.
